messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Do not use Flonase nasal spray:
- if you are allergic to fluticasone or to any of the other ingredients
- to treat asthma
- if you have had an injury to your nose, or surgery on your nose, that is not fully healed.
To make sure Flonase is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have ever had:
- sores or ulcers inside your nose;
- injury of or surgery on your nose;
- glaucoma or cataracts;
- liver disease;
- diabetes;
- a weak immune system; or
- any type of infection (bacterial, fungal, viral, or parasitic).
If you use Flonase without a prescription and you have any medical conditions, ask a doctor or pharmacist if this medicine is safe for you.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
Triplet: ["Flonase Nasal Spray", "requires medical evaluation before use", "pregnancy or breastfeeding"]

The relation 'requires medical evaluation before use' in the triplet is defined as 'Patients with the condition specified by the object entity should consult a healthcare professional before using the subject medication.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
B. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'may require temporary discontinuation before': The subject medication might need to be stopped temporarily prior to undergoing the specified medical procedure.
E. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
